documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.storage_: The Storage Grid Directory keeps compact per-type item counts and exposes a standard item inventory to Bookwyrms, pipes, and dimensional network pathways. Its base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items. Install up to four Grid Expansion Repositories in its GUI; each adds 64 types and 262,144 items. Each expansion consumes an Ars Nouveau Repository in its recipe. Link an Advanced Storage Lectern to the directory with a Dominion Wand to search, extract, and craft from the grid. Breaking the directory preserves its contents and installed upgrades in the dropped directory item.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.category.descript: Core structures, devices, and upgrades from Ars Arcane Matrix.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.overv: The $(item)Arcane Matrix Core$() is the final reward of the mineral-processing line. Its recipe requires all five Sourcelinks plus the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher crystals. Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Arcane Structural Frame around it.$(br2)It starts when at least one ring is complete; other rings may be expanded block by block, while six axial Arcane Amplifiers add 25% generation each.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.overv: Build consecutive 3, 5, 7, and 9-wide inverted-beacon layers above the $(item)Arcane Mine$(). The first layer is a cheap bootstrap made from five Source Gem Blocks at its center/corners and four Sourcestone cardinal markers. From layer two onward, every other position requires Arcane Structural Frames. The layers unlock wood-, stone-, iron-, and diamond-tier ores.$(br2)The Mine never buffers Source. Once all production conditions are met, it checks nearby networks and deducts the complete operation cost only when the full amount is available. Four layers expand its range to 32 blocks and allow loaded Matrix Cores.$(br2)Gem-block corners mark whitelist samples; Sourcestone cardinal centers mark blacklist samples. End-tier ores such as Iesnium explicitly require layer four.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.cycle: Use the Matrix to supply Source to both the Mine and the Arcane Imbuement Core, then have the Mine produce Lapis Ore. Break it with $(thing)Fortune$() and send Lapis Blocks to the Core for bulk conversion into Source Gems. Return only enough gems to replenish the Mine's material points; the remaining Lapis need not be imbued.$(br2)This creates an automatable material loop, but mining and imbuement still consume Source generated by the Matrix.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.ampli: In a complete four-layer Mine, every 128 material points consumed are equivalent to one 1% $(item)Arcane Amplifier$() roll. An Amplifier is guaranteed after 12,800 points without one. Expensive minerals advance both chance and pity faster, and success resets progress. Place at most one in each completed layer center to add one ordinary ore and raise Source and material costs by 50%.$(br2)Amplifiers that cannot be exported use a separate 64-item core buffer. Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_c: The Arcane Matrix Core is the final reward of mineral processing. Five Sourcelinks prove mastery of conventional Source, while all three processing crystals prove completion of the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher. One complete 5 by 5 ring is required to start it.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_m: The first Mine layer is an alloy-free bootstrap: five Source Gem Blocks mark its center and whitelist corners, while four Sourcestone blocks mark blacklist edges. From layer two onward, all remaining positions require Arcane Structural Frames, so the first copper, gold, and amethyst must be collected manually. Layers unlock wood, stone, iron, and diamond mining tiers; end-tier ores such as Iesnium are locked to layer four.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_a: The Arcane Amplifier is a rare byproduct of a complete four-layer Arcane Mine. Every 128 material points consumed are equivalent to one 1% roll, with a guarantee after 12,800 points without success; cheap minerals do not receive equal roll efficiency. In a Matrix, replace up to six axial Source Gem Block vertices; each adds 25% of base Source generation. In a Mine, replace one center Source Gem Block per completed layer; each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_i: The Arcane Imbuement Core is a standalone bulk Source Gem converter and no longer requires an Imbuement Chamber. Bind output and input inventories in that order with a Dominion Wand. It pulls nearby Source and processes up to four inputs every five seconds by default. Lapis Lazuli and Amethyst Shards each cost 500 Source and yield one Source Gem; Lapis Blocks yield nine and Amethyst Blocks yield four. Compact mode converts every four Gems into a Source Gem Block. Surplus Arcane Amplifiers can also be recycled. Redstone pauses processing.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_s: The Source Stone Generator is one compact controller for bulk stone and soil production. With no pedestal recipe it produces 64 Cobblestone after 200 progress. It gains 20 passive progress per second without Source. When Source is available, a batch takes five seconds; place Arcane Amplifiers directly north, south, east, and west to reduce that duration by one second each, down to one second. Non-empty Arcane Pedestals anywhere in the surrounding 3 by 3 by 3 area are matched unordered and exactly against data-pack recipes, and their items are not consumed. The nine-slot output buffer pushes into the inventory below and is extractable from every face. Redstone pauses operation.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.source_stone_gene: The $(item)Source Stone Generator$() produces 64 Cobblestone when no pedestal recipe matches. It gains 20 progress each second naturally; nearby Source shortens a standard batch to five seconds.$(br2)Place up to four $(item)Arcane Amplifiers$() directly north, south, east, and west. Each removes one second from powered processing, reaching one batch per second with all four. Non-empty Arcane Pedestals in the surrounding 3×3×3 area select exact, unordered data-driven recipes without consuming their contents.$(br2)Outputs are buffered and pushed into a container directly below. Pipes may extract from any face. Redstone pauses operation.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_a: The Arcane Hunting Grounds only reproduces milestone rewards tied to a boss identity or defeat event. Hearts of the Sea, Echo Shards, smithing templates, and Dragon Heads are structure loot handled by Alakarkinos exploration instead. The Grounds consumes no Source, creates no entity, posts no death event, produces no experience, and never reads ordinary loot tables.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.over: Use a $(item)Netherite Block$() as the Enchanting Apparatus reagent, surrounded by a Drygmy Charm, Conjuration Essence, Nether Star, Wilden Tribute, Dragon's Breath, Source Gem Block, Casting Crystal, and Enriched Mineral Crystal, to create the $(item)Arcane Hunting Grounds$(). These three challenge materials require the player to personally reach and complete the corresponding boss progression before automation is unlocked. Place one Mob Jar directly above the Grounds and at least two Arcane Pedestals within two blocks horizontally.$(br2)Conjuration Essence adds 10 points; a Condensed Summoning Core adds 100. The stored creature is only an identity sample and is never spawned, harmed, or released.
ars_arcane_matrix.glyph_desc.glyph_captu: Captures a touched non-boss creature into an empty Containment Jar in the caster's inventory. Amplify switches the glyph to boss-only capture mode.

book.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.auto: Each target is defined by a data-pack rule containing its point cost and boss milestone output. Default rules produce Nether Stars from Withers, Wilden Tributes from Wilden Chimeras, and Dragon Eggs from Ender Dragons. Structure loot belongs to Alakarkinos exploration, while ordinary creature drops belong to Drygmy Henges.$(br2)Ordinary loot tables, death events, boss sounds, experience, and environmental death effects are never invoked. Production takes five minutes by default; adjacent inventories receive outputs and redstone pauses operation.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_: The $(item)Arcane Imbuement Core$() is a standalone bulk converter. It neither requires an Imbuement Chamber nor upgrades ordinary imbuement recipes; a future upgraded chamber is a separate device.$(br2)Use a Dominion Wand to bind output first and input second; sneak-use clears both bindings. The Core pulls nearby Source itself, and redstone pauses processing.

$(item)Bulk Imbuement$()$(br)Up to four inputs finish per five-second cycle by default. One Lapis Lazuli or Amethyst Shard costs 500 Source and yields one Source Gem; a Lapis Block costs 4,500 Source and yields nine, while an Amethyst Block costs 2,000 Source and yields four. An Arcane Amplifier costs 2,000 Source and recycles into sixteen Source Gems.$(br2)Empty-hand use toggles output mode. Loose mode outputs individual Source Gems. Compact mode turns each group of four into a Source Gem Block and preserves the remainder.
A complete four-layer Arcane Mine rolls for an $(item)Arcane Amplifier$() according to actual material consumed: every 128 points equal one 1% roll, with a guarantee at 12,800 points. Expensive minerals advance faster and success resets progress.$(br2)If the output is blocked, the Mine stores up to 64 Amplifiers in a separate internal buffer.

$(item)Arcane Matrix$()$(br)Replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of the unamplified generation rate, up to a total bonus of 150%.

$(item)Arcane Mine$()$(br)Replace the center Source Gem Block of each completed layer, up to four. Each Amplifier adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%. At four Amplifiers, ordinary output is 5x and costs are 3x.$(br2)Surplus Amplifiers can be recycled in either an ordinary Imbuement Chamber or the Arcane Imbuement Core.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.info: Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Arcane Structural Frame around the core. It generates Source when at least one ring is complete; other rings may be expanded block by block. Build the Matrix before scaling the Mine and mineral-processing line.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.amplif: Any of the six axial vertices may be replaced with an Arcane Amplifier. Each adds 25% of base generation, for a total bonus of 150%.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.i: The 3x3 first layer needs five Source Gem Blocks at its center/corners and four Sourcestone blocks at its cardinal edges—no alloy. From layer two onward, keep those gem and Sourcestone markers but fill every other position with Arcane Structural Frames. Consecutive 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, and 9x9 layers unlock wood, stone, iron, and diamond mining tiers.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.t: Source Gem Block corners are whitelist markers: hang ore samples beneath them. Sourcestone blocks at the north, south, east, and west centers are blacklist markers. The blacklist always excludes afterward; duplicate samples add no weight and incomplete-layer samples do nothing.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.a: One Arcane Amplifier may occupy each completed layer center, up to four. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%. At full amplification, ordinary output is 5x and costs are 3x. In a complete four-layer Mine, every 128 material points consumed equal one 1% Amplifier roll, with a guarantee at 12,800 points.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.i: A rare full-mine byproduct rolled from actual material consumption: every 128 material points equal one 1% roll, guaranteed at 12,800 points.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.m: In an Arcane Matrix: replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of base Source generation, up to six for a total bonus of 150%.

In an Arcane Mine: place at most one in the center of each completed layer. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. The byproduct amount stays at one; the higher actual material cost advances its roll and pity proportionally.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.r: Recycling: an ordinary Imbuement Chamber converts one Arcane Amplifier into four Source Gem Blocks for 2,000 Source. The Arcane Imbuement Core can instead output sixteen Source Gems or four Source Gem Blocks according to its mode.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_c: A standalone bulk Source Gem converter that requires no Imbuement Chamber. It accepts Lapis Lazuli, Amethyst Shards, their storage blocks, and Arcane Amplifiers.
Lapis: one Lapis Lazuli costs 500 Source and produces one Source Gem; a Lapis Block costs 4,500 Source and produces nine. Up to four inputs are processed together in five seconds by default.

Amethyst: one Shard costs 500 Source and produces one Source Gem; an Amethyst Block costs 2,000 Source and produces four. Compact mode waits for four Gems before exporting a Source Gem Block. Each Arcane Amplifier costs 2,000 Source and recycles into sixteen Gems or four Gem Blocks.

The Core pulls up to 100,000 Source per second by default. Use a Dominion Wand to bind output first and input second; sneak-use clears both. Up to four inputs finish together in five seconds by default. Redstone pauses processing.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.source_stone_gener: A single compact generator for data-driven, bulk stone and soil production. With no matching pedestal recipe it produces 64 Cobblestone after 200 progress, gaining 20 passive progress per second even without Source.

It reads every non-empty Arcane Pedestal in a 3x3x3 area centered on the generator. Items are matched unordered and exactly and are not consumed. External Source gives a five-second cycle. Arcane Amplifiers directly north, south, east, and west reduce it to four, three, two, then one second.
The nine-slot buffer pushes into the inventory directly below. Pipes may extract from every face. A blocked output stops progress and Source use; redstone pauses operation.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.info: Place a Mob Jar directly above the Arcane Hunting Grounds and at least two Arcane Pedestals anywhere in its nearby detection volume. Conjuration Essence is worth 10 points and a Condensed Summoning Core is worth 100.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.drops: Only boss milestone rewards are produced. Structure loot belongs to Alakarkinos exploration and ordinary drops to Drygmy Henges. The Grounds never creates or kills entities, posts death events, plays boss sounds, or awards experience.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.autom: After the configured target cost is paid, one cycle takes five minutes by default. Outputs are pushed into adjacent inventories and may be extracted from every side. Redstone pauses operation.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting_guide.inf: Open the Wixie Order Terminal, view an ordinary crafting recipe in JEI, and press the recipe-transfer button to consume one blank guide from your inventory and encode that exact recipe. The off-hand sample and Crafting Table method remains available, but JEI is unambiguous when an output has multiple recipes.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting_guide.fuz: Tag Preference chooses an available member only from the original recipe Ingredient and still validates the final grid against that recipe. Strict Recipe fixes every Ingredient to its first preferred member. Sneak-right-click an encoded guide to toggle modes. Inputs with non-default components default to Strict Recipe.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: Early Wixie crafting and storage management are separate systems. The Order Terminal, virtual Order Pedestal, Pattern Provider, and Wixie workstations handle crafting requests only; the native Storage Lectern and Bookwyrm network manage storage. Later, an Advanced Storage Lectern combines storage browsing and crafting requests. Use a Dominion Wand to link an Automatic Stock Request Display to both a target inventory and either an Order Terminal or Advanced Storage Lectern. When its displayed item falls below the configured minimum, it consumes one Manipulation Essence from its internal catalyst slot and submits one configured batch order. When that slot is empty, it automatically takes one Manipulation Essence already stored in the Order Terminal's shared network inventory. Hoppers, pipes, or Starbuncles may also refill the slot from any side; nearby pedestals are never read. Encode guides through JEI transfer or an off-hand output sample. A Pattern Provider starts with 27 guide slots and can be upgraded to 54, 81, then 108 slots. Sneak-use a network device with an empty hand to display its working range. Wixies draw from Dominion-bound shared inputs, return intermediates to the input pool, and route final products to output storage. Ordinary non-special Crafting Table recipes are currently supported.
The Order Terminal selects an output, calculates its materials, and sends a virtual request to the Wixie network.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.inf: Processes minerals in #c:ores, #c:raw_materials, and #c:dusts that have furnace recipes, plus vanilla raw metal blocks. It smelts a mixed batch of up to 64 items every five seconds; dust yield is determined by its recipe.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.str: Empty-hand right-click the core to preview the 3x3x2 structure. Leave the block above the core empty as the furnace mouth, place an Arcane Pedestal above it for fuel, and build all remaining positions from Sourcestone or Smooth Sourcestone.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_smelter.aut: The Dominion Wand's first connection binds output and its second binds input. Redstone pauses the machine. Lava buckets return their empty buckets.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.enchanted_archwood: Crafted from one Enchanted Crystal and eight Archwood logs. It powers 128 Arcane Smelter operations and enables Casting Crystal byproducts. After completing the mineral line, combine eight Enchanted Archwood Charcoal, one Casting Crystal, one bucket of lava, and 2,000 Source in an Arcane Reaction Vessel to make a block with ten times one charcoal's burn duration. Inserting either enchanted fuel immediately replaces unfinished ordinary fuel.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.casting_crystal.so: Casting Crystals are produced only by an Arcane Smelter fueled with Enchanted Archwood Charcoal and gate the next Crusher stage.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.casting_crystal.pi: Enchanted fuel mode rolls a 12.5% chance for every 16 minerals processed. The eighth roll after seven failures is guaranteed, so one appears after at most 128 minerals.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_s: The Arcane Smelter is the second stage of the mineral-processing line. It uses vanilla furnace fuels to process mixed batches of ores, raw minerals, raw metal blocks, and dusts, totaling up to 64 every five seconds. Supply fuel through the upper Arcane Pedestal; Enchanted Archwood Charcoal enables Casting Crystal byproducts. Bind input and output with a Dominion Wand, and empty-hand right-click the core to preview its structure.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.earth_: Earth Essence is drawn from an ordinary inventory within three blocks. This mode keeps Archwood-related output, doubles the whole cycle, and gains speed from nearby plant families.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.advanc: Ancient Grove Catalyst is drawn from an ordinary inventory within three blocks. This mode keeps only Archwood logs, quadruples the whole cycle, and gains speed from nearby plant families.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisprig.consum: A catalyst is consumed only after Source is paid and production begins. Logs, leaves, and saplings of one plant count as one family. Up to five families each reduce work time by 10%.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.burn_sherd.bootstr: Give an appropriate pottery sherd to an Alakarkinos so it can perform native work or expeditions.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisp: The Whirlisprig draws Earth Essence or Ancient Grove Catalyst from ordinary inventories within three blocks; without a catalyst, native behavior is unchanged. Both grove modes read ecological diversity within five blocks. Logs, leaves, and saplings of one plant count as one family; up to five families each reduce work time by 10%.

Keep the Whirlisprig near the grove center and place an Earth Essence inventory within three blocks. Mix Archwood, flowers, crops, berries, or ancient plants nearby; output filtering removes unwanted products. Each successful cycle consumes one essence and doubles Archwood-related output. Five plant families reduce work time to 50%.

Ancient Grove mode uses the same ecological layout; replace Earth Essence with Ancient Grove Catalyst. Each successful cycle consumes one catalyst, keeps only Archwood logs, and quadruples the whole cycle. Ecological diversity affects speed only and does not multiply output again.

Whirlisprig groves primarily serve the Archwood chain. Special modes already filter output, so different Archwood species and a few representative plants can share a compact grove. Repeating one family does not add speed. Bulk ordinary crops should still use Ars Nouveau growth and harvest systems.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.advanced_imbuement: The Advanced Imbuement Chamber uses the ordinary chamber's recipes, pedestal matching, automation, and rotating model, and appears in the same JEI Imbuement category. With external Source it draws up to 2,000 Source per second and reduces recipe preparation to one second.

Without an external Source provider it retains Ars Nouveau's slow 10 Source per second passive accumulation and does not scale that free progress. High-speed operation therefore requires Source infrastructure. Ordinary chambers remain unchanged.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.formless_essence.i: Around an ordinary or Advanced Imbuement Chamber, place all seven native Essences and one Wilden Tribute on eight pedestals. Imbue an Amethyst Cluster with 2,000 Source to produce four Formless Essences. Pedestal items are catalytic and are not consumed.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.formless_essence.c: Shapelessly combine Formless Essence with a supported Essence to produce two of that Essence. All seven native Essences and Ars Elemental's Anima Essence are supported.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.advanced: The Advanced Imbuement Chamber inherits every ordinary Imbuement recipe, eight-pedestal check, automation behavior, and rotating animation. After completing the Smelter stage, upgrade an ordinary chamber in an Enchanting Apparatus using two Enchanted Crystals, four Casting Crystals, two Source Gem Blocks, and 25,000 Source. It unlocks before the Crusher to supply elemental essences in bulk. With external Source it draws up to 2,000 per second and prepares recipes in one second. Without a provider it remains at the native passive rate of 10 Source per second.

The Formless Essence recipe works in either an ordinary or Advanced Imbuement Chamber. Put all seven native Essences and one Wilden Tribute on eight surrounding pedestals, then imbue an Amethyst Cluster with 2,000 Source to produce four Formless Essences. Pedestal catalysts are not consumed. Shapeless conversion supports every native Essence.
ars_arcane_matrix.ritual_desc.rare_creat: Consumes one Source Jar and summons a Breeze. Reinforced Deepslate, Prismarine Bricks, Gilded Blackstone, and Purpur select a Warden, Elder Guardian, Piglin Brute, and Shulker. Each activation summons one sample and ends.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.inf: Every five seconds, the Crusher consumes one Essence from the upper pedestal to process a mixed batch of up to 16 minerals. Raw minerals yield two dust by default and ore blocks yield one; Air Essence raises these to three and two respectively.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.com: Automatically recognizes metal ores and raw minerals and finds a compatible dust. Iron, copper, gold prefer this mod's dusts. Redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, and Amethyst Clusters are excluded. Ancient Debris uses a special recipe and receives the normal ore-block Air Essence yield bonus.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_crusher.aut: The Dominion Wand's first connection binds output and its second binds input. Empty-hand right-click previews the 5x3x2 grinding frame. The upper pedestal supplies Essence, and redstone pauses operation.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.enriched_mineral_c: Water Essence mode makes a 12.5% roll for every 16 minerals processed. The eighth roll after seven failures is guaranteed to produce an Enriched Mineral Crystal.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_c: The Arcane Crusher is the third mineral-processing stage. It discovers metal dusts through common tags and consumes one Essence every five seconds to process a mixed batch totaling up to 16 items. Air Essence on the upper Arcane Pedestal increases dust yield; Water Essence keeps the base yield and enables Enriched Mineral Crystal byproducts. Bind input and output with a Dominion Wand, and empty-hand right-click the core to preview its structure.
tooltip.ars_arcane_matrix.construction_w: Right-click a core: place one missing structure block
Sneak-right-click a core: complete as much of the structure as possible
In Creative, right-click builds everything without materials

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.amethyst: Every five seconds, the Amethyst Golem recognizes Amethyst Blocks, Budding Amethyst, and Arcane Pedestals within ten blocks in every direction from its home. A pickaxe on a pedestal is simulated without being consumed. Efficiency shortens both growth and harvest cooldowns and actions; at Efficiency V each action takes about one second. Each growth action also performs one plus the Efficiency level random ticks on every Budding Amethyst. Efficiency never changes the five-minute Amethyst Block conversion cooldown. Fortune affects normal drops, while Silk Touch harvests intact Clusters. A Hopper on a second pedestal teleports products into the home inventory without voiding overflow.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.amethyst_golem_enh: Place a pickaxe on an Arcane Pedestal within ten blocks of home. Efficiency shortens growth and harvest cooldowns and actions, and gives every Budding Amethyst one plus the Efficiency level growth attempts. Efficiency V uses a one-second action and six attempts per block. Conversion keeps its five-minute cooldown. Fortune increases drops and Silk Touch yields intact Clusters. The tool is never damaged.
Place a Hopper on another nearby Arcane Pedestal to teleport Amethyst Shards and Clusters within ten blocks into the golem's home inventory. Items remain in the world when that inventory is full.

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.starbunc: Register tamed Starbuncles within 32 blocks through a Dominion Wand or the GUI scan. The hub preserves their visible route behavior while accelerating container transfers through one shared throughput budget; adding Starbuncles cannot exceed the hub tier. Each worker keeps independent 27-slot virtual filters and matching settings. Invalid routes may be recalled manually or automatically, with charms and undelivered items entering the 18-slot maintenance buffer.

tooltip.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_source_: Structure: Incomplete; Source input and output are disabled
tooltip.ars_arcane_matrix.integrated_sou: On-demand access to the linked Source network
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_n: Place the Matrix Source Reservoir Core at the midpoint of any lower outer edge of a hollow 7×7×7 structure. Fill the caps with Arcane Structural Frames and the middle walls with Tinted Glass; the interior may contain a Matrix or any other blocks. Once formed, it stores 100,000,000 Source and actively gathers from Sourcelinks and Matrix Cores within 24 blocks. It never drains machines or other jars. Integrated Source Relays supply devices; cross-dimensional links require an Advanced Storage Lectern and loaded remote chunks.
Loaded area: the single chunk containing this block
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.dimensio: The Dimensional Anchor consumes 100 Source per second from providers within 8 blocks and fully ticks its own chunk. Missing Source, a redstone signal, or breaking the block immediately releases the chunk ticket. An expensive early recipe uses diamond blocks, Source Gem Blocks, and a Lodestone. After the mineral-processing line, Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched crystals provide a cheaper recipe. Cross-dimensional Source and storage networks require one anchor in each remote node's chunk.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarkinos_expedi: Route proof: placed on another Arcane Pedestal near the home and not consumed

Place a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal within three blocks of an Alakarkinos home to enable container exploration. It only extracts blocks from nearby inventories and never breaks placed blocks; the home receives rewards.
Sand and gravel directly reuse Ars Nouveau's weighted archaeology recipes. Other blocks use this mod's data-driven exploration pools. When a route needs a proof, place it on another nearby pedestal.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarki: With a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal near its home, an Alakarkinos rapidly consumes exploration blocks from nearby inventories. Sand and gravel retain Ars Nouveau's native archaeology tables, while other blocks use this mod's data-driven pools. This mode never breaks placed world blocks.

Tame an Alakarkinos normally, give it a pottery sherd to wear, and bind a container as its home. Put a Brush on an Arcane Pedestal within three blocks and place exploration blocks in inventories within the same range. The home receives rewards. Nothing is charged early when materials, Source, or output space are insufficient.

Cobblestone, dirt, sculk, netherrack with blackstone, end stone, and tuff select different exploration pools. Ancient City sculk can be produced by the Source Stone Generator at high Source cost when a Sculk Catalyst is on a pedestal. Trial routes also read a Trial Key or Ominous Trial Key from a nearby pedestal. JEI lists exact costs.
Ars Arcane Matrix connects Ars Nouveau into a linked production system. Begin with the Arcane Imbuement Core and Source Stone Generator, master all five Sourcelinks, and establish an Arcane Matrix before expanding the Mine. Its ores then unlock the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher in sequence, followed by Wixie automation, grid storage, and logistics.

The Imbuement Core converts lapis or amethyst into Source Gems in bulk; the generator supplies structure blocks; the mine gathers ore. Enchanted Crystals from the Processor unlock the Smelter, Casting Crystals unlock the Crusher, and Enriched Mineral Crystals feed advanced automation, storage, and expeditions. Check a byproduct's uses in JEI whenever the next step is unclear.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.construc: Use an empty hand on a multiblock core to show missing-block projections. Use the Matrix Construction Wand on the core to place one missing block, or sneak-use it to build as much as inventory materials permit. Creative mode ignores materials. The wand also validates spaces that must remain empty, but only reports obstructions and never destroys existing blocks.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.multiblo: This is a multiblock device. Use an empty hand on its core to display missing blocks. Use the Matrix Construction Wand to place one missing block, or sneak-use it to place as many as possible. Creative mode may complete it without materials.

This ore-processing structure is a prototype and its shape will be redesigned. Use an empty hand on the core for the current projection, then use the Matrix Construction Wand: normal use places one missing block and sneak-use places as many as possible. Do not treat the current silhouette as final.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_p: The Processor is the first ore-processing stage. It accepts intact ore blocks and simulates the tool on its pedestal. It processes up to five ores in parallel. Food supplies runtime, while magical food immediately switches it into a special mode that advances the Enchanted Crystal byproduct.

Bind ore input and product output to the core with a Dominion Wand. The two symmetric pedestals above the core's left and right sides are interchangeable; the machine identifies food and tools from their contents. Efficiency, Fortune, and Silk Touch follow machine rules. Experience-bearing ores produce experience gems. Redstone pauses work and blocked products remain buffered internally.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_e: A Drygmy Henge reads weapons on nearby Arcane Pedestals as simulated kill tools. Sharpness improves speed, Looting increases rewards, and beheading effects can participate in the simulated kill. Only targets worth substantial experience produce noticeable experience gems.
Pedestal weapons are not consumed. The Henge also has improved per-operation Source transfer and clearly reports when Source is missing.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.stock_re: The Automatic Stock Requester monitors one item in a linked target container. When stock falls below its threshold, it submits one configured order to a linked Wixie Order Terminal and consumes one Manipulation Essence from linked storage.

Use its GUI to select the item, threshold, request amount, and enable automation, then link the target container and order terminal. It will not resubmit while an order is pending. Success, missing essence, planning failure, and unavailable networks are reported in chat.
The Advanced Storage Lectern searches linked containers and Storage Grid Directories and provides a collapsible 3x3 crafting area. Bookwyrms establish storage links; the lectern browses and manipulates the network instead of requiring Bookwyrms to physically carry every item.

Grid directories excel at many copies of relatively few items. Base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items. Up to four Grid Expansion Warehouses may be installed; each adds 64 types and 262,144 items. Equipment with many unique components is a poor fit. Breaking the directory preserves inventory and upgrades in the dropped item.

The lectern supports search, sorting, scrolling, a collapsible crafting area, and JEI uses/recipes for virtual items. It can also bridge cross-dimensional storage and Source networks. Remote nodes must remain chunk-loaded through a Dimensional Anchor or equivalent.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.logistic: The Starbuncle Logistics Hub manages registered Starbuncles, increases endgame transfer throughput, and shows each Starbuncle's input, output, and target container. Filters, match modes, and current selection are saved per Starbuncle.

Each Starbuncle has an independent 27-slot virtual filter with allowlist, denylist, and matching modes. The hub can recall invalid-route or all Starbuncles and protects registered workers from transport hazards, pushing, and prolonged jams. Filter samples are never consumed.

All routes share one throughput budget: 256 items/s at base, then 1,024, 4,096, and 16,384 through the Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched upgrades, reaching 32,768 items/s with the grid-stage upgrade. Ordinary pickup preserves tier, registrations, and filters; an Enchanting Apparatus upgrade must be scanned and registered again. Real items in the 18-slot buffer drop when broken.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_n: The Arcane Source Jar is a pre-Mine 1,000,000-Source buffer that actively gathers nearby Sourcelink output and directly supplies machines. The Matrix Source Reservoir is its post-processing multiblock upgrade and does nothing while incomplete. Integrated Source Relays supply linked devices, Advanced Storage Lecterns bridge dimensions, and Dimensional Anchors keep remote chunks loaded.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.integrat: The Integrated Source Relay is the machine-facing output of a large Source network. It draws from a bound Matrix Core, completed Matrix Source Reservoir, or Advanced Storage Lectern and exposes that Source through an Ars Nouveau-compatible provider for nearby machines. Its early recipe uses four ordinary relays and a Source Gem Block; after unlocking the Crusher, four Enriched Mineral Crystals provide an alternative recipe.

Use a Dominion Wand on the relay and its supplying node in either order; sneak-use a node with the wand to clear its links. Like a Source Pathway, the relay accesses its linked network on demand instead of filling a local buffer first. A Matrix Core can supply it directly in the same dimension. Cross-dimensional transfer still requires an Advanced Storage Lectern and loaded remote chunks through a Dimension Anchor.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.rare_rit: The Lost Calling Ritual only obtains a creature sample that is difficult to renew or locate reliably. Add its tablet and one augment to a Ritual Brazier and activate it. The ritual consumes one Source Jar, creates one target, and immediately ends. Bring a Containment spell and an empty Mob Jar; the ritual does not contain or continuously produce creatures for you.

No augment summons a Breeze. Reinforced Deepslate, Prismarine Bricks, Gilded Blackstone, and Purpur select a Warden, Elder Guardian, Piglin Brute, and Shulker. Withers and Ender Dragons already have proper summoning or revival methods and are excluded. After containment, use Arcane Hunting Grounds for boss milestones, Alakarkinos for exploration rewards, and Drygmy Henges for ordinary drops.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.troubles: When a machine does not work, check structure completion, redstone power, available Source, input/output links, output capacity, and whether the item has a supported recipe. Inspect projections with an empty hand, read Jade status, and confirm recipes and modes in JEI.

Dominion Wand interaction takes priority over empty-hand interaction. Truly empty your hand to switch modes; hold the wand and click in the documented order to create links. If a container rejects an untyped input, seed it with one target item or inspect its face and filter configuration.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: Prepare one Wixie workstation with a summoned Wixie, an Arcane Order Pedestal, Pattern Provider, Order Terminal, at least one encoded Crafting Guide, and Dominion-bound shared input and output containers. The workstation and pedestal must be within network range. Sneak-use a device with an empty hand to display that range.

Use the JEI transfer button to encode a Crafting Table recipe into a blank Crafting Guide, then store it in the Pattern Provider. Select an output and quantity in the terminal. It recursively plans intermediates and sends virtual tasks to the Order Pedestal while multiple Wixies execute steps in parallel. Intermediates return to shared input storage and final products enter the bound output. Missing materials are listed by the terminal.
New players should begin here for device order, material loops, and multiblock construction.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.whirlisp: Enable grove mode with Earth Essence or Ancient Grove Catalyst in an inventory, then gain speed from nearby plant diversity; without a catalyst, native behavior remains unchanged.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.alakarki: Alakarkinos consume bulk terrain and metal blocks to simulate vanilla structure chests.
The Advanced Storage Lectern unifies linked inventories, grid directories, and autocrafting access.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.troubles: When a device stops, check structure, redstone, Source, links, output space, and recipe support first.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.order_pe: The Order Pedestal marks a virtual crafting task sent by the terminal; players never place or retrieve output samples on it.

Place the Order Pedestal within the Wixie crafting network's range. After an order is placed, it displays the current virtual task and awaited materials. Wixies still draw real ingredients from Dominion-bound shared input containers and deliver final products through workstation output links. No finished-product container is required beneath the pedestal.

A base pedestal dispatches every 0.5 seconds and permits one parallel job. Upgrade it as an Enchanting Apparatus reagent through gold, diamond, and netherite blocks, using Manipulation Essence, the matching stage crystal, and 1, 2, then 4 Sourcebound Copper Alloy. The tiers permit 2, 4, then all available Wixies in parallel; the final tier dispatches every 0.05 seconds. Upgrades never shorten a workstation's real processing time.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.crafting: A Crafting Guide stores one ordinary Crafting Table recipe for Pattern Providers and order planning. Inverse 1-to-4/9 single-material compression recipes are treated as storage operations and consume no Source.

The easiest method is to open the desired Crafting Table recipe in JEI, carry a blank guide, and press the recipe-transfer plus button. Alternatively, hold the output sample offhand and use a blank guide on a Crafting Table. Craft an encoded guide by itself in a shapeless grid to clear it back into a blank guide.

Sneak-use an encoded guide to toggle Tag Preferred or Strict Recipe mode. Tag Preferred lets the network choose available ingredients from compatible tags; Strict accepts only the concrete ingredients required by the encoded recipe. Encoded rendering shows the target item in front of a small Crafting Table icon.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.pattern_: The Pattern Provider stores Crafting Guides and exposes their recipes to nearby Order Terminals and Wixie workstations.

Place encoded guides in its GUI. The provider discovers workstations with summoned Wixies inside its range; sneak-use it with an empty hand to display that range. Wixies use Dominion-bound shared input and output containers—the provider is not an ingredient inventory. One provider can serve several workstations participating in parallel orders.

A base provider stores 27 guides. Upgrade it as an Enchanting Apparatus reagent through gold, diamond, and netherite blocks, using the matching stage crystal, Manipulation Essence, and 1, 2, then 4 Sourcebound Copper Alloy to reach 54, 81, and 108 slots. Existing guides are preserved.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.grid_dir: The Storage Grid Directory uses a Repository Controller as its index core, then folds warehouse space through four Arcane Structural Frames and Enriched Mineral Crystals. It exposes compact storage to lecterns, Bookwyrms, pipes, and automation.

Base capacity is 16 types and 4,096 items. Its GUI directly accepts and returns items and has dedicated slots for up to four Grid Expansion Warehouses. Once linked, an Advanced Storage Lectern can search, withdraw, and autocraft from it. Breaking the directory stores inventory and upgrades in the dropped block. Equipment with unique affixes, durability, or components consumes separate types and is better kept in conventional storage.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.grid_exp: A Grid Expansion Warehouse seals a Repository's capacity with four Arcane Structural Frames and Enriched Mineral Crystals. It installs inside a Grid Directory GUI instead of being placed, and acts as a repeatable late-game sink for the advanced alloy line.

Each expansion adds 64 item types and 262,144 total items. One directory accepts up to four. Expansions may be removed and moved, but only reduce capacity after the remaining stored contents fit within the smaller limits.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.dimensio: A Dimensional Anchor consumes Source to keep its own single chunk fully ticking.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.sourcebound_copper: The early recipe turns three Copper Ingots, one Gold Ingot, one Quartz Block, and one Source Gem into two alloys. Quartz acts as an arcane flux, while the first copper, gold, and amethyst must still be collected manually.

After completing the mineral line, three Copper Dust, one Gold Dust, and one each of the Enchanted, Casting, and Enriched Mineral Crystals produce eight alloy dust. Smelting yields eight alloys—four times the early alloy yield from the same metals.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.starbuncle_hub.upg: All Starbuncles managed by one hub share its throughput. Tiers 0 through 4 move 256, 1,024, 4,096, 16,384, and 32,768 items/s respectively; adding Starbuncles does not increase the hub total. Upgrade it through the Enchanting Apparatus. Filtering, protection, teleport, and recall are fully available at the base tier.

documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_r: The Arcane Reaction Vessel is a Novice Spell Book material-conversion machine crafted from Smooth Sourcestone, a Cauldron, ordinary Source Gems, a Source Jar, and a Hopper. It consumes up to two item types, one fluid, and Source without requiring Blaze Rods or a Brewing Stand.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_s: The Arcane Source Jar is a pre-Mine 1,000,000-Source buffer that actively gathers nearby Sourcelink output, overcoming the response delay of ordinary jars and relays.

Once per second it gathers from loaded Sourcelinks within 12 blocks, taking at most 10,000 from each and 50,000 total. It never drains machines or other jars, preventing storage loops, and ordinary Ars Nouveau machines may draw from it directly.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_r: Items and fluids may enter or leave from any side. Four Glass, 250 mB of water, and 200 Source produce one Nether Quartz in ten seconds, providing a safe but slower Hardcore alternative. Sixty-four Stone, 2,000 mB of water, and 800 Source become 64 Infested Stone in five seconds for a Novice Vitalic Source farm. See JEI for other reactions.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_f: The Arcane Fluid Controller collects, sorts, stores, and wirelessly transports any registered fluid. It includes one fluid tank; installing Arcane Fluid Reservoirs in its dedicated slots lets it manage up to three fluid types.

The menu selects the range-collection target and default output reservoir. Use a Dominion Wand on the controller then a container to bind output; reverse the order to bind input. Capacity, Range, and Speed use ordinary upgrade slots, while Arcane Fluid Reservoirs use dedicated slots and cannot be removed while nonempty. The controller never creates lava by itself.
The Arcane Fluid Reservoir is a placeable single-fluid container holding 64,000 mB. It may also be installed as an expansion module inside an Arcane Fluid Controller.

Use a fluid container on the block to insert or withdraw fluid; pipes may access it from any side. Breaking the reservoir preserves its contents, while crafting it by itself clears them. Only an empty reservoir can be installed in a controller, preventing hidden or lost fluid during expansion.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_v: The Arcane Vacuum Hopper directly teleports dropped items and vanilla experience orbs through walls. Its range can be 4, 8, or 12 blocks, or the hopper's entire chunk; larger ranges use longer scan intervals. Redstone pauses collection, conversion, and output.

Use an empty hand to open the menu or sneak-use to deposit all player experience. Items and experience gems have separate buffers and Dominion Wand output targets. Filter templates support disabled, whitelist, or blacklist behavior plus ignored or strict NBT/component matching; voiding only destroys filter matches. Experience can remain stored or become normal or Greater Experience Gems.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.source_s: The Source Stone Furnace is a fuel-free Wixie automation workstation supporting both smelting and smoking recipes. Each item takes five seconds and pays 20 Source once when processing begins.

The furnace has only input and output slots: ingredients enter from above by default and results leave below. Wixie Pattern Providers recognize it for recursive orders containing smelted intermediates; normal crafting dispatch speed never skips its real processing time.
message.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_vacuum_: The target is not a valid item container
Cleared item and experience-gem output bindings
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.stock_re: The Automatic Stock Request Display shares one limit for its monitored target and each automatic request. The base limit is 64; Enchanting Apparatus upgrades raise it to 256, 1,024, and 9,999. Its material progression matches the Wixie order devices, and breaking the block preserves its tier.
